description: Semi-global (fitting) pairwise alignment with affine gap costs: by default sequence1 is aligned end to end inside sequence2 (free leading/trailing sequence2 residues, endGaps = 'Fitting'); the optional endGaps parameter selects any of the 16 end-gap policies (overlap / suffix-prefix in both orientations, sequence2 inside sequence1, all four ends free = EMBOSS needle's default -endweight N, none = global); a gap of length k scores gapOpen + k·gapExtend, a free end gap 0. Equals Biopython PairwiseAligner(mode='global', end_insertion_score=0 for the default; left/right_insertion/deletion_score = 0 in general) and parasail sg_dx (sg_* variants). With the default endGaps startPosition2/endPosition2 report the fitted interval of sequence2 (0-based inclusive; the free flanks lie outside it; an empty interval has endPosition2 = startPosition2 - 1) and startPosition1/endPosition1 span the whole query; for any endGaps they are the consumed intervals of each sequence. With matrix = BLOSUM62 | PAM250 | EDNAFULL the alignment is scored by that published residue-pair table (protein or IUPAC DNA, any symbol of the matrix) instead of match/mismatch and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (EMBOSS needle/water 6.6.0 = Biopython PairwiseAligner = parasail on >1000 oracle rows; EMBOSS -gapopen G -gapextend E = gapOpen -(G - E), gapExtend -E); exactScore is then the real-valued score (score = rounded). Matrix mode accepts protein sequences (no DNA validation). Memory: inputs above 25,000,000 dynamic-programming cells ((len1+1)*(len2+1), e.g. two 5 kb sequences) are aligned automatically in exact LINEAR SPACE (Hirschberg 1975 / Myers-Miller 1988 / Huang-Miller 1991-style locate-then-solve) - the returned score, rows and coordinates are identical to the full-matrix result (ties included), only the running time grows (about 1.3-2x) and the memory stays O(len1 + len2) instead of O(len1 * len2) (20 kb x 20 kb affine: 111 MB peak instead of 4.8 GB).

gapOpen.description: Gap-open score added once per gap run (negative = penalty). May be fractional when matrix is given; EMBOSS gapopen G / gapextend E = gapOpen -(G - E), gapExtend -E.

gapExtend.description: Gap score per gap position, in addition to gapOpen for the first one. May be fractional (e.g. -0.5) when matrix is given.

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS or NCBI name - BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM30 ... EBLOSUM90, EPAM10 ... EPAM500 (protein) or EDNAFULL, EDNAMAT, EDNASIMPLE, ENUC.4.4 (IUPAC DNA). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

endGaps.description: Which end gaps are free (default 'Fitting' = the classic semi-global: free leading/trailing sequence2 residues). Comma-separated, case-insensitive names of the flags FreeStart1 (leading sequence1 residues free), FreeEnd1 (trailing sequence1), FreeStart2 (leading sequence2), FreeEnd2 (trailing sequence2) or of a preset: None (= global, all end gaps penalised; result tagged Global), Fitting (FreeStart2+FreeEnd2; sequence1 inside sequence2; parasail sg_dx, Biopython end_insertion_score=0), FittingSequence2 (FreeStart1+FreeEnd1; sequence2 inside sequence1; sg_qx), OverlapSuffix1Prefix2 (FreeStart1+FreeEnd2: a suffix of sequence1 overlaps a prefix of sequence2; sg_qb_de), OverlapSuffix2Prefix1 (FreeEnd1+FreeStart2; sg_qe_db), All (all four free; parasail sg, EMBOSS needle's default -endweight N). Example: 'FreeStart1,FreeEnd2'. startPosition1/endPosition1 and startPosition2/endPosition2 are the consumed intervals of each sequence (the free flanks lie outside them; an empty interval has end = start - 1); a free flank is shown against '-' in the aligned rows.

alignedSequence1.description: Aligned sequence1 (free flanks shown against '-'; reproduces the full sequence1).

score.description: Optimal score under the end-gap policy.

alignmentType.description: Alignment type ("SemiGlobal"; "Global" when endGaps is None).

startPosition1.description: First sequence1 index consumed by the alignment path: 0 unless leading sequence1 residues are free (FreeStart1 / overlap policies).

startPosition2.description: First sequence2 index consumed by the alignment (fitted-interval start = number of free leading reference residues).

endPosition1.description: Last sequence1 index consumed by the alignment path: query length - 1 unless trailing sequence1 residues are free; an empty interval has endPosition1 = startPosition1 - 1.

endPosition2.description: Last sequence2 index consumed by the alignment (fitted-interval end); an empty interval has endPosition2 = startPosition2 - 1.

exactScore.description: Real-valued score (equals score for integer scoring; with matrix/fractional gaps score is this value rounded half away from zero).

examples.name: Overlap (suffix of sequence1 = prefix of sequence2)
